# Foremention

> Foremention is recommendation intelligence for B2B software. It preserves buyer-question observations and evidence, separates what a company can prove from what it cannot, turns reviewed gaps into customer-owned Change Specifications, and supports comparable later measurement without inventing causal claims.

## Core

- [Product](https://foremention.com/product): Product workflow and decision boundaries.
- [Recommendation Intelligence](https://foremention.com/recommendation-intelligence): Public category definition.
- [Recommendation Record](https://foremention.com/recommendation-record): Canonical measurement object and evidence-chain explanation.
- [Methodology](https://foremention.com/methodology): Measurement, evidence, review, and comparability methodology.
- [Glossary](https://foremention.com/glossary): Canonical product and evidence terminology.
- [Trust Center](https://foremention.com/trust): Security, privacy, reliability, and evidence boundaries.
- [Design Partner Application](https://foremention.com/contact): Founder-led design-partner application.

## Research

- [Research and evidence](https://foremention.com/insights): Public research index.
- [AI visibility measurement](https://foremention.com/insights/ai-visibility-measurement): Measurement limits and interpretation.
- [SEO and GEO technical checklist](https://foremention.com/insights/seo-geo-technical-checklist): Public technical guidance.

## Company

- [About](https://foremention.com/about): Company and product purpose.
- [Privacy](https://foremention.com/privacy): Privacy practices.
- [Subprocessors](https://foremention.com/subprocessors): Subprocessor information.
- [Terms](https://foremention.com/terms): Terms of use.

## Optional

- [Full LLM context](https://foremention.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded product and evidence context.
- [Markdown sitemap](https://foremention.com/sitemap.md): Human- and agent-readable public site map.
- [Homepage markdown](https://foremention.com/index.md): Markdown mirror of the homepage's core public claims and workflow.

- [Product Markdown](https://foremention.com/product.md): Structured public product workflow and honest constraints.
- [Methodology Markdown](https://foremention.com/methodology.md): Structured measurement and comparability methodology.

- [Recommendation Record Markdown](https://foremention.com/recommendation-record.md): Canonical record identity, evidence stages and comparison gate.
- [Recommendation Intelligence Markdown](https://foremention.com/recommendation-intelligence.md): Category scope and evidence-first terminology.
